Bay Area.wearEn: Short sleeves by day · a layer at night

Grand Canyon.wearEn: Big swing in temp · puffy in the morning

2026-09-22.labelEn: Shopping · World Market · River Park · home by 6

2026-09-23.blurbKo: 낮 Sphere 외관 → 저녁 KÀ → 밤 벨라지오 분수. AV/Zoox는 시간 되면만.
2026-09-23.blurbEn: Daytime Sphere exterior → evening KÀ → night Bellagio fountains. AV/Zoox only if you have energy.

highlights.textKo: Sphere 외관 포토 — 내부 투어 필수 아님
highlights.textEn: Sphere exterior photos — indoor tour not required
KÀ at MGM, then over to the Bellagio fountains

highlights.textKo: AV / Zoox — 컨디션 되면만 · 필수 아님
highlights.textEn: AV / Zoox — only if energy allows · not required

2026-09-17.blurbKo: 정오 출발 → 3시 체크인 → 러버스 포인트·아시로마 태평양 해안 산책 후 캐너리로.
2026-09-17.blurbEn: Leave at noon → check in around 3 → walk Lovers Point and Asilomar, then Cannery Row.

2026-09-21.blurbKo: 점심 Dog House 후 Belmont → Target Herndon → HomeGoods/TJ → Costco(마지막 그룹) → 집(Angie 드롭). 프로판은 윤 혼자 Tractor Supply.
2026-09-21.blurbEn: Lunch at Dog House, then Belmont → Target Herndon → HomeGoods/TJ → Costco (last group stop) → home to drop Angie. Propane is Yoon solo at Tractor Supply.

2026-09-22.titleKo: 쇼핑 · 캡틴 크랩 · 월드마켓 · River Park · 6시 전 귀가
2026-09-22.titleEn: Shopping · Captain Crab · World Market · River Park · home by 6
2026-09-22.blurbKo: 블랙스톤 쇼핑 → Captain Crab → World Market 짧게 → River Park 파머스 마켓은 5시 오픈에 맞춰 짧게만. 5:40 출발, 6시 전 귀가. 비행 전날.
2026-09-22.blurbEn: Blackstone shopping → Captain Crab → short World Market browse → River Park graze at 5pm open. Leave by 5:40 to be home by 6. Flight eve.

2026-09-26.blurbKo: 잰 집 출발 → PHX 에이비스 반납 → AA 1919 (~15:51 FAT) → 저녁 6–9:30 마이클 댕 한국 가족 모임 (1374 N Kaweah Ave).
2026-09-26.blurbEn: Leave John's → return Avis at PHX → AA 1919 (~15:51 FAT) → Host Korean Family at 1374 N Kaweah Ave, 6–9:30pm.

cannery-row.whatKo: 몬터레이 바닷가 산책로 · 옛 정어리 공장 거리
cannery-row.whatEn: Monterey waterfront walk · old sardine-cannery street
cannery-row.factKo: 스타인벡 소설 『Cannery Row』의 무대. 바다사자·해달이 자주 보여요.
cannery-row.factEn: Setting of Steinbeck's novel Cannery Row. Sea lions and otters show up a lot.

alvarado-brewery.factKo: 로컬 몰트·홉으로 내리는 하우스 맥주가 메인.
alvarado-brewery.factEn: House beers brewed with local malt and hops.

17-mile.whatEn: Pacific Grove–Pebble Beach paid coastal drive
17-mile.factKo: Lone Cypress는 약 250년 된 사이프러스 한 그루가 바위 위에 서 있는 상징 스팙.
17-mile.factEn: The Lone Cypress is a ~250-year-old cypress standing on a rock — the iconic stop.
17-mile.tipKo: 아침 일찍이 한산 · 게이트 통과비 있음
17-mile.tipEn: Quieter early · there's a gate fee

stanford-shopping.whatKo: 스킨포드 쇼핑센터 안 Alo Yoga · On 매장
stanford-shopping.whatEn: Alo Yoga and On stores inside Stanford Shopping Center
stanford-shopping.factKo: 대학 옆 야외몰 — 두 브랜드가 같은 센터에 있음
stanford-shopping.factEn: Open-air mall next to campus — both brands are in the same center.
stanford-shopping.tipEn: Alo first, then On — keep it short.

google-visitor.whatEn: Public visitor space on the Google campus
google-visitor.factKo: Shoreline 쪽 방문자 경험 — 로고·기프트숍 위주. 내부 사무실은 출입 제한.
google-visitor.factEn: Visitor experience near Shoreline — logos and a gift shop. Offices are badge-only.

apple-park.factKo: 링 형태 본사(Apple Park)를 밖에서 볼 수 있는 유일한 공개 공간. 옥상 정원·애플스토어.
apple-park.factEn: The only public spot to see the ring-shaped headquarters from outside. Rooftop garden and Apple Store.
apple-park.tipEn: If it's still light, go up to the roof

sjsu.whatEn: Public university campus in the heart of Silicon Valley
sjsu.factKo: 캘리포니아에서 가장 오래된 공립 고등교육 기관 중 하나(1857).
sjsu.factEn: One of California's oldest public higher-ed campuses (1857).
sjsu.tipEn: Keep it to a short campus walk in the evening

santana-row.whatEn: San Jose's European-style shopping and dining street
santana-row.factKo: 보행자 중심 거리 — 저녁 산책·식사 코스로 유명.
santana-row.factEn: Pedestrian street — known for evening walks and dinner.
santana-row.tipEn: Park once and walk a loop

levis-stadium.whatEn: Santa Clara MLS and NFL stadium
levis-stadium.factKo: 49ers 홈구장. 어스쿄이크스(Earthquakes)도 여기서 홈 경기를 치려요.
levis-stadium.factEn: Home of the 49ers. The Earthquakes play home games here too.
levis-stadium.tipKo: 조금 일찍 나와 주차장 혼잡 피하기
levis-stadium.tipEn: Leave a little early to dodge parking traffic

kpcf.factKo: 프레즈노 한인 커뮤니티의 중심 예배 공간.
kpcf.factEn: A central worship space for Fresno's Korean community.
kpcf.tipEn: Arrive in time for the service

sphere.whatEn: Las Vegas's giant LED spherical venue
sphere.factKo: 2023년 개장. 외벽 Exosphere는 세계 최대급 LED 디스플레이로 밤낮 다른 비주얼.
sphere.factEn: Opened in 2023. The Exosphere outer wall is one of the world's largest LED displays — different by day and night.
sphere.tipKo: 낮엔 외관·주변 산책만으로 충분 · 내부 쇼는 별도 티켓
sphere.tipEn: Daytime exterior and a walk around is enough · indoor shows need a separate ticket

ka.whatEn: Resident Cirque du Soleil show (MGM Grand)
ka.factKo: 기울어지는 무대·공중 액션이 특징인 KÀ — MGM에서 장기간 상연 중.
ka.factEn: KÀ is known for the tilting stage and aerial work — a long-running show at MGM.
ka.tipKo: 공연 후 벨라지오로 이동 여유 두기
ka.tipEn: Leave a little cushion after the show to get to Bellagio

bellagio.whatEn: The Strip's famous outdoor fountain show
bellagio.factKo: 1998년부터 운영. 음악에 맞춰 물기둥이 춤추는 무료 쇼로 라스베이거스 상징.
bellagio.factEn: Running since 1998. A free show where water dances to music — a Las Vegas icon.
bellagio.tipKo: 밤 쇼가 더 예쁘요 · 인도 쪽 난간이 잘 보임
bellagio.tipEn: Night shows look better · the sidewalk rail is a good view

hoover.whatEn: Big dam on the Colorado River · viewpoint
hoover.factKo: 1930년대 대공황 시기 건설. 당시 세계 최대급 콘크리트 댐이었고, 호수 Mead를 만들었어요.
hoover.factEn: Built in the 1930s during the Depression. It was among the world's largest concrete dams and created Lake Mead.
hoover.tipEn: Security screening · bring water and a hat

seligman.whatEn: Town where the Route 66 restoration movement began
seligman.factKo: 1987년 Angel Delgadillo가 루트66 보호 운동을 시작해 'Birthplace of Historic Route 66'로 불려요.
seligman.factEn: In 1987 Angel Delgadillo started the Route 66 preservation effort — it's called the Birthplace of Historic Route 66.
seligman.tipEn: Keep it to Snow Cap and a photo stop

grand-canyon.whatEn: Grand Canyon National Park South Rim
grand-canyon.factKo: 콜로라도강이 약 600만 년에 걸쳐 깎아 만든 협곡. 사우스림은 전망 포인트가 차로 이어져 접근이 쉬워요.
grand-canyon.factEn: The Colorado River carved this over about 6 million years. South Rim viewpoints are linked by road, so it's easy to reach.
grand-canyon.tipKo: 일출·일몰은 재킷 필수 · 난간 밖 금지
grand-canyon.tipEn: Jacket for sunrise and sunset · stay inside the rail

prescott.factKo: 해발 ~1,600m. 카우보이 역사와 Whiskey Row로 알려진 조용한 타운.
prescott.factEn: About 1,600 m / 5,200 ft. Quiet town known for cowboy history and Whiskey Row.

yosemite-mist.whatEn: Yosemite Valley · classic views and trail
yosemite-mist.factKo: Tunnel View는 Half Dome·El Capitan이 한 프레임. Mist Trail은 Vernal Fall 옆을 지나는 인기 하이킹.
yosemite-mist.factEn: Tunnel View frames Half Dome and El Capitan. Mist Trail is the popular hike along Vernal Fall.
yosemite-mist.tipEn: Water, watch your footing · check entry reservations and traffic

reedley-pavilion.factKo: 2010년 제막. 서울 독립문 축소 모형과 안창호·이승만 등 초기 한인 독립운동가 기념비.
reedley-pavilion.factEn: Dedicated in 2010. A scaled Independence Gate from Seoul, plus memorials to early Korean independence figures like Ahn Changho and Syngman Rhee.
reedley-pavilion.tipEn: Central Valley Korean immigration and independence-movement site

dinuba-31.factKo: 1920년 3월 1일, 당시 북미 한인 밀집지 디누바에서 3·1 운동 1주년 퍼레이드가 열렸어요.
dinuba-31.factEn: On March 1, 1920, Dinuba — then a dense Korean community in North America — held a parade for the movement's first anniversary.
dinuba-31.tipEn: A short heritage stop together with Reedley

fruit-stand.factEn: September is peach, plum, and grape season. Farm stands are common.
fruit-stand.tipEn: Cash vs card varies by stand

mgm.factKo: KÀ 공연장이 호텔 안에 있어 당일 숙박하면 이동이 편해요.
mgm.factEn: The KÀ theater is inside the hotel, so staying the show night keeps the walk short.

lovers-point.whatKo: 퍼시픽 그로브 태평양 해안 · 바위 절벽과 산책로
lovers-point.whatEn: Pacific Grove coast · rocky bluffs and a walking path
lovers-point.factKo: 숙소에서 10–15분. 러버스 포인트에서 바다를 바로 보고, Ocean View Blvd를 따라 아시로마까지 드라이브·산책.
lovers-point.factEn: 10–15 min from the hotel. See the water at Lovers Point, then drive or walk Ocean View Blvd toward Asilomar.
lovers-point.tipKo: 바람 셈 · 겹옷. 캐너리로 전에 사진 쭍기 좋은 구간.
lovers-point.tipEn: Windy · bring a layer. Great photo stretch before Cannery Row.

river-park-market.whatEn: River Park Tuesday farmers market · food trucks and produce
river-park-market.factKo: The Shops at River Park (Cedar / Via 근처). 화 5–9pm. 오픈에 맞춰 도착하고 짧게만.
river-park-market.factEn: The Shops at River Park (near Cedar / Via). Tue 5–9pm. Arrive at open; keep it short.

world-market.whatEn: River Park home and imported goods (Blackstone)
world-market.factKo: 7662 N Blackstone Ave Suite A. 캡틴 크랩 다음, 화요 마켓 5시 전 짧게.
world-market.factEn: 7662 N Blackstone Ave Suite A. After Captain Crab, short browse before the 5pm market.
world-market.tipEn: Tue 10am–8pm · short browse · home by 6 still holds
